directionTooltips.BULLISH: The price is expected to rise
directionTooltips.BEARISH: The price is expected to fall
directionTooltips.NEUTRAL: No significant price movement is expected

actionTooltips.BUY_PULLBACK: Buy after a short-term price decline
actionTooltips.BUY_BREAKOUT: Buy after the price moves above resistance
actionTooltips.SELL_RALLY: Sell after a short-term price rise
actionTooltips.SELL_BREAKDOWN: Sell after the price moves below support
